name: U-Net
output: 逐像素前景/多类别分割图
output_en: Pixel-accurate foreground or multi-class segmentation map

nodes.label: 输入图像
nodes.description: 原始实现结合强弹性形变增强以扩充少标注数据。
nodes.description_en: Strong elastic deformation augments the small annotated biomedical image set in the original training recipe.

nodes.label: 高分辨率 Encoder
nodes.description: 重复 3×3 Conv 提取边缘、纹理与小结构位置。
nodes.description_en: Repeated 3×3 convolutions capture local boundaries, texture and fine spatial detail.

nodes.label: 下采样金字塔
nodes.description: max pooling 逐级扩大视野并增加通道。
nodes.description_en: Max pooling reduces spatial resolution; deeper levels increase channel capacity and capture a wider context.

nodes.label: 语义瓶颈
nodes.description: 最低分辨率层编码大范围上下文与任务语义。
nodes.description_en: The lowest-resolution level aggregates the broadest context. The original architecture reaches 1024 feature channels here.

nodes.label: Up-conv
nodes.description: 转置卷积提升空间分辨率并降低通道。
nodes.description_en: Learned up-convolution increases spatial resolution and reduces channel count before decoder fusion.

nodes.label: 同尺度 Concat
nodes.description: 裁剪/对齐 encoder 特征后与 decoder 特征按通道拼接。
nodes.description_en: Crop the encoder feature map to align spatial sizes, then concatenate it with the decoder features along the channel axis.

nodes.label: Decoder Conv
nodes.description: 融合定位与语义后逐级细化边界。
nodes.description_en: Convolutions after concatenation combine fine localization with deeper semantic context and refine the predicted boundaries.

nodes.label: 1×1 分割头
nodes.description: 将最终特征映射为每像素类别 logits。
nodes.description_en: A 1×1 convolution maps the final features to per-pixel class logits.

name: ResNet
input: 2D 图像或 3D 体数据特征
output: 分类 logits、金字塔特征或下游编码表示
output_en: Classification logits, multi-scale feature pyramid, or downstream encoded representations

nodes.label: Stem
nodes.description: 卷积与下采样建立第一层局部特征。
nodes.description_en: Initial convolutional stem and downsampling extract low-level local features.

nodes.label: 块输入 x
nodes.description: 同时进入残差分支与恒等捷径。
nodes.description_en: Splits tensor simultaneously into the non-linear residual branch and the identity shortcut.

nodes.label: F(x)
nodes.description: BasicBlock 用两层 3×3；Bottleneck 用 1×1–3×3–1×1。
nodes.description_en: BasicBlock stacks two 3×3 convolutions; Bottleneck uses a 1×1–3×3–1×1 channel compression-expansion design.

nodes.label: Identity
nodes.description: 维度不变时直接传递；变化时用 projection shortcut。
nodes.description_en: Passes features directly when dimensions match, or applies a 1×1 projection shortcut when stride/channels change.

nodes.label: 残差相加
nodes.description: 计算 y=x+F(x)，保留近似恒等映射与短梯度路径。
nodes.description_en: Computes y = x + F(x), preserving an unattenuated identity reference and short gradient highway.

nodes.label: 分层 Stage
nodes.description: 重复残差块并逐级降低分辨率、增加通道。
nodes.description_en: Stacks residual blocks across stages while progressively halving spatial resolution and doubling channels.

nodes.label: 全局平均池化
nodes.description: 把最终空间特征聚合为图像级向量。
nodes.description_en: Pools final spatial feature maps into a global image-level representation vector.

nodes.label: 任务头
nodes.description: 连接分类头，或把多尺度 stage 特征交给检测/分割解码器。
nodes.description_en: Feeds the classification head or exports multi-scale stage features to detection/segmentation decoders.

name: Vision Transformer (ViT)
output: CLS 全局表征或类别概率
output_en: Global [CLS] representation, patch token grid, or classification logits

nodes.label: 输入图像
nodes.description: 图像被规则切成互不重叠的 P×P 区块。
nodes.description_en: Ingests fixed-resolution 2d image (or 3d sub-volume patches) and prepares initial tensor representations (Input Image).

nodes.label: Patchify
nodes.description: 每个 patch 展平，使二维空间问题变成长度 N 的序列。
nodes.description_en: Executes Patchify to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.

nodes.label: 线性 Patch 嵌入
nodes.description: 共享线性投影把每个 patch 映射到 D 维 token。
nodes.description_en: Performs Patch embedding within the core patch token encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: CLS + 位置
nodes.description: 序列前置可学习 CLS token，并叠加可学习绝对位置编码。
nodes.description_en: Performs CLS + within the core patch token encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: 全局 MSA
nodes.description: 所有 patch token 在每层内进行全局多头自注意力。
nodes.description_en: Performs global MSA within the core patch token encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: MLP Block
nodes.description: 两层前馈网络逐 token 做通道变换；MSA 与 MLP 均带 pre-norm residual。
nodes.description_en: Performs MLP Block within the core patch token encoder computation pathway.

nodes.label: L× Encoder
nodes.description: 重复 Transformer encoder，空间分辨率与 token 数保持不变。
nodes.description_en: Applies L× Encoder to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.

nodes.label: CLS Head
nodes.description: 取最终 CLS 状态，经 LayerNorm 与线性头完成分类。
nodes.description_en: Produces global [cls] representation, patch token grid, or classification logits via CLS Head.
